Chapter 1192 - 12: The New Treasure Land (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1192: Chapter 12: The New Treasure Land (Please Subscribe)

Long Shuang Hou exhaled gently, facing the threat of a Heavenly Venerate, he did not plan to resist.

Although he had many life-saving methods, even a Heavenly Venerate couldn’t completely kill him.

But offending a Heavenly Venerate would have too many consequences.

"Hmm? Is this a Heavenly Cold Fruit?"

Long Shuang Hou’s pupils contracted upon seeing a fruit exuding a cold aura appear beside him.

The Heavenly Cold Fruit was a rare treasure at the Venerable level, even of great use to a Peak Venerable.

"This Heavenly Cold Fruit, was it left by that mysterious Heavenly Venerate? To exchange for my five drops of vital blood?"

Long Shuang Hou put away the Heavenly Cold Fruit, carefully examining it, feeling a strange sense of curiosity in his heart, "That mysterious Heavenly Venerate, surprisingly merciful?"

Logically, with the strength of a Heavenly Venerate, personally arriving and asking for five drops of vital blood required no compensation.

For a Venerable, vital blood is certainly precious, but losing five drops would have no real impact on oneself.

There was absolutely no need for a transaction.

The only hidden risk of vital blood outside was it could become a ’medium’ for cause and effect, allowing other powerful beings to use it to attack through causal means.

But this hidden risk has nothing to do with a Heavenly Venerate.

If a Heavenly Venerate wanted to kill him, they could have done so just now, without needing causal means.

And causal assassination would have its power diminished, even a strong Heavenly Venerate could only severely injure him, and only this particular physical form.

That’s why Long Shuang Hou felt a bit ’unsettled’, perceiving the earlier mysterious Heavenly Venerate as merciful.

As for the rule among the six Ancient Countries that Venerate-level fighters are not allowed to intervene... as long as no one knows which Heavenly Venerate made a move, the six Ancient Countries have no grounds for investigation.

Earlier, when Beiyin Venerable Sage and Jihan Venerate infiltrated the Hei Yu Nest, the same principle applied.

...

"Twelve Venerable-level strongmen’s vital blood has already been collected."

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, although at the moment he was just an avatar, dealing with Venerable-level fighters was still effortless.

Even so, when Lin Yuan obtained the vital blood of a Venerable from the Xuanyin Ancient Country, he left behind some rare treasures as an exchange for their vital blood.

It wasn’t out of Lin Yuan’s kindness, but such actions would minimize potential dangers.

Indeed, most Venerables facing the threat of a Heavenly Venerate would obediently hand over their vital blood, not daring to speak up afterward.

But in case a minority of reckless Venerables felt indignant and magnified the issue to the Xuanyin Ancient Country’s royal family.

This would become troublesome for Lin Yuan as well.

Perhaps it could even lead to an investigation by the Heavenly Venerate of the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

Engaging in these quasi-transactions for the vital blood from Xuanyin Venerables, was viewed by Lin Yuan as the most stable approach.

Most importantly, a mere Venerable-level rare treasure didn’t hold Lin Yuan’s attention, especially after the wealth increase from the ancient Heavenly Venerates Jihan and Beiyin.

"It’s a pity, if I could obtain the vital blood of the Xuanyin royal family, it would be even better."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, but he was already quite satisfied with acquiring the vital blood from over ten Venerables.

Life forms that have cultivated to the Venerable level certainly have no diluted ancestral bloodline, even if not as pure as the royal family, it should be close enough, providing Lin Yuan ample time for future insights.

"Continue collecting more Venerable-level vital blood."

Lin Yuan placed the collected vital blood with another avatar for direct insights, while this avatar continued to other domains to seek more Xuanyin Venerables.

The task of gathering Xuanyin Venerable’s vital blood came with some risks, so naturally, Lin Yuan wouldn’t bring the vital blood back to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, but rather ponder it in the Xuanyin Ancient Country.

Even if any issue arose afterward, he could eliminate the avatar in an instant, leaving no trace for anyone to follow.

...

In the capital of Fierce Sun, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in his mansion, where the avatar pondered on the vital blood of Xuanyin Venerables, while the true self also synchronized in contemplation.

[Your insight is extraordinary, the unknown vital blood comprehension raises your understanding of the Xuanyin Dao]

Lin Yuan was immersed in his enlightenment, finding the Dao within the Xuanyin bloodline as vast and grand as, if not surpassing, the Chaos.

"Xuanyin... Taiyin..."

Countless insights and enlightenments surged in Lin Yuan’s mind.

[Your insight is extraordinary, understanding the Xuanyin Dao enhances your recognition of the Taiyin Dao]

In a haze, Lin Yuan visualized a Tai Chi Diagram, within which the Taiyin side stirred ripples, continuously transforming with the Taiyang side.

...

While comprehending the Xuanyin Venerable’s vital blood, Lin Yuan did not neglect the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram.

Until now, he recognized two ways to hasten the evolution of the Chaotic Taiji Dao, one was to comprehend the Xuanyin Dao, to complement the Taiyin Dao, thus advancing the Taiji Dao.

The other was to deepen his understanding of the Chaos Rule, achieving Third Realm within the Chaos Rule could also advance the Taiji Dao.

The two approaches, one internal and one external.

Both were significantly beneficial to Lin Yuan, and even without the evolution of the chaotic Taiji Dao, continued enlightenment would still yield great personal improvement.

...

In the vast Origin World.

The six Ancient Countries occupied the most central and prosperous regions.

Beyond the six Ancient Countries, there were also large areas, though slightly more barren compared to the six Ancient Countries, still fostering treasure lands and secret realms that many Venerables explore and travel through.

After all, the treasure lands contained within the six Ancient Countries have basically all been occupied, and ordinary Great Lords can’t even get close.

Rumble.

In a stretch of winding mountains, a violent fluctuation of time and space suddenly erupted, and a mysterious aura began to spread in all directions.

This kind of aura immediately caught the attention of the nearby passing Great Lords, who all looked towards the source of the time-space fluctuation, their eyes wide open.

"A treasure land, this is an anomaly that a treasure land has bred, has a new treasure land been born?"

"At least a first-class treasure land has emerged to emit such an aura, a first-class treasure land?"

All the Great Lords who witnessed this scene gulped; a first-class treasure land? Even the lofty six Ancient Countries would strive with all their might to compete for it, and now they had stumbled upon it?

Currently, the number of first-class treasure lands occupied by the six Ancient Countries is extremely few and incredibly rare.

"Let’s go and take a look."

A Great Lord, with a surged heart, immediately moved closer to the winding mountains where the treasure land was being bred.

...

Da Ling Ancient Country.

Among the six Ancient Countries, Da Ling Ancient Country was the third to be established. It is said that the founder of Da Ling Ancient Country was the disciple of the initial Primordial Spirit ancestor.

At this moment, the emperor of Da Ling Ancient Country and many Heavenly Venerates were gathered in the main hall.

"A new treasure land has appeared here, it should be a first-class treasure land, though the effects of its peculiar treasures are unknown, they should be related to time. Currently, any Great Lord approaching a certain distance from the treasure land will be forcibly pushed back to their original position by the power of time."

"A treasure land breeding peculiar treasures related to time, and it’s a first-class treasure land? This treasure land must be seized."

"Indeed, it might help us take the last step to break through the cycle of time. Any peculiar treasure related to time must not be overlooked."

One Heavenly Venerate after another from Da Ling Ancient Country swiftly made their decision.

The peculiar treasures bred by a first-class treasure land are immensely useful to Heavenly Venerates and even to Peak Venerables, and the peculiar treasures related to time make all Heavenly Venerate-level experts envious.

So far, among the many first-class treasure lands controlled by the six Ancient Countries, only five are related to time.

On average, there’s not even one per Ancient Country.

"You want to seize this treasure land, and other Ancient Countries want to seize this treasure land as well."

Sitting high on his throne, the emperor of Da Ling looked down and said, "Currently, this treasure land has been controlled, but its ownership will still be contested by the Heavenly Venerates of the Ancient Countries according to the old rules."

If a newly born treasure land is located within the territory of a particular Ancient Country,

then without a doubt, this treasure land belongs to that Ancient Country.

But now the location of this treasure land is outside the six Ancient Countries, so its ownership needs to be contested by the six Ancient Countries.

...

Galaxy Royal Mansion.

Lin Yuan was in seclusion.

At that moment, he received a message from the emperor of Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

"Galaxy, come to see me immediately." The emperor of Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s tone was quite urgent, and Lin Yuan immediately realized something significant had happened.

Before long.

Lin Yuan arrived at the palace.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan saw many Heavenly Venerates waiting outside.

These Heavenly Venerates glanced at Lin Yuan but said nothing more.

Feeling puzzled, Lin Yuan still proceeded directly into the palace.

"Galaxy."

The Fierce Sun emperor looked at Lin Yuan and said with a smile, "All those Heavenly Venerates outside want to see me, but I chose to see you first."

"Why is that?" Lin Yuan immediately inquired.

"A new first-class treasure land has appeared, and it’s outside the territories of the six Ancient Countries," the emperor of Fierce Sun Ancient Country said succinctly.

"A new first-class treasure land?" Lin Yuan was a little surprised.

Given his current status, he naturally understood the importance of a first-class treasure land; the peculiar treasures bred were of immense help to Heavenly Venerates.

Lin Yuan himself sat at two first-class treasure lands, so he was very clear about this.

These are treasure lands that have already existed for countless ages, with the peculiar treasures bred mostly already distributed once over.

But a newly emerged treasure land, and the peculiar treasures it breeds, have never appeared among the six Ancient Countries and are most able to incite the scramble among the Heavenly Venerates of the six Ancient Countries.

"Our six Ancient Countries have long established rules that if a treasure land’s ownership is unclear, then it is to be decided according to the established rules as to which Ancient Country it belongs to."

The emperor of Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan and said, "The rule here is that each major Ancient Country selects twelve Heavenly Venerates to compete outside the treasure land."

"Those Heavenly Venerates outside all want me to choose them as part of the twelve Heavenly Venerates sent by my Fierce Sun Ancient Country to compete."

The emperor of Fierce Sun Ancient Country paused his speech for a while and then continued, "According to the rules, even if those Heavenly Venerates involved in the competition fail in the end, the benefits they gain in the treasure land are still allowed to be taken out."

"So that’s how it is."

Lin Yuan suddenly understood that regardless of whether they can seize this treasure land in the end, the Heavenly Venerates involved in the competition are guaranteed to gain benefits.

"Of course, I have the final say on which Heavenly Venerates can go to compete." The emperor of Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan and smiled, "Galaxy, are you interested?"
